answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 10226 Country: India Title: Can we use (a.s) alaihis salaam when referring to the Prophets companions and his family members or we should only use (r.a) radiallahu anho when referring to them? Question: Can we use (a.s) alaihis salaam when referring to the Prophets companions and his family members or we should only use (r.a) radiallahu anho when referring to them? Answer ID: 10226 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 84/84=M/1429) Saying raziAllahu anhu for sahaba is the characteristic of Ahlus Sunnah; therefore we should use raziAllahu anhu for the sahaba and the family members of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) instead of alaihis salam . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
